objective: Complete Android Community Wall optional interstitial opportunities after frequently successful comments, on post-detail editor blur/back and photo-comment sheet close, preserving existing cadence and all production Season1/Season2 reward rules. DEV source only; release into staging requires independent CI and OTA verification.
productionBaselineEvidence: Staging base commit 42779df703aa26fb07e56f726865deef8bcb7ec8 was verified by read-only GitHub branch-ref fetch. The current live Android OTA identity, runtime and AdMob production fill are not verified. No edit to production main or Supabase backend is authorized by this scope.
chosenApproach: Reconcile on exact consolidated Season2 staging source, reuse the existing centralized AdMob interstitial and five-free/every-fifth-extra comment cadence, and consume the pending opportunity only at post-detail focus loss or photo-sheet close. Add in-flight comment guard and runnable focused regression tests. Do not add SDK, change ad units, increase interstitial frequency, or modify points.
selectionRationale: Public and scoped editor closures already consume comment ad opportunities; post detail only warms and the Wall photo comment sheet only records/warm, so those two entrypoints silently lose otherwise eligible opportunities. Small client-only fixes preserve ad policy, submission performance and consolidated staging source.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Add natural-break-only Android interstitial triggers in existing public Wall post comment viewers without new native modules or different app initialization.
preservedBehaviors: Post creation, comment submission, replies, photo comments and offline handling never depend on AdMob success.
Existing SDK consent, Ad-Light, safe-route and no-fill protections remain authoritative.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Extend post detail and Wall photo-comment close behavior without touching photo/video rendering, scroll and interactive media lifecycle.
preservedBehaviors: Wall feed and post detail video decoding, photo collage, reactions, comments, drafts and instant navigation remain unchanged.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Post detail useFocusEffect cleanup now serves as a natural editor-exit opportunity while remaining isolated by signed-in account and existing route protections.
preservedBehaviors: Authenticated post detail navigation, report protection, account isolation and public Wall navigation remain functional.
Ad opportunities never block successful comment submission or modify rewards.

acceptanceChecks: First five successful comments per Manila day are ad-free; sixth and every fifth extra success queue at most one optional interstitial on next editor close.
Post detail and photo-comment close consume pending ad once; no ad during text input, RPC submission, or for failed/duplicate submissions.
Global Android safety controller still enforces two distinct eligible actions, interaction locks, route restrictions, AdMob consent, Ad-Light and remote flags.
AdMob decides the actual interstitial creative (video or static); do not promise or fabricate a video creative or impression.
Existing Community Wall, scoped Community, post detail, photo comments, media playback, first-view ad and instant dashboard navigation regression suite must pass.
Only source-level readback passed so far; focused Node test, TypeScript/Android compile and served staging OTA identity require independent verification.
Never update main, production channel, production APK, Play release or Supabase database in this PR. Season2 rewards remain off until independently approved after December 6.
releaseTarget: staging source PR only; no OTA
